RedMagic 12 Pro+ Tease Pendingin Cair RGB Pertama di Industri, Rilis 15 Oktober

Red Magic has released teaser for its upcoming flagship, the Red Magic 12 Pro+, ahead of its scheduled October 15 launch . According to announcements shared via the brand’s official Weibo account and General Manager Jiang Chao, the device will introduce what the company describes as the industry’s first RGB water-cooled thermal management system in a smartphone . The cooling system inside the Red Magic 12 Pro+ incorporates a dual-ring circulation layout that expands flow-channel volume and surface area compared to the previous Red Magic 11 Pro+. Driven by an internal micro-pump, the coolant splits into two primary paths:

The two circulation paths converge before extending into the airflow chamber, where an integrated cooling fan expels the heat externally to achieve hybrid air-and-liquid thermal dissipation. To support the expanded channel capacity and higher resistance, Red Magic upgraded the pump hardware to a dual-crystal driven micro-pump. The unit delivers an operating output pressure of 130 kPa—up from 100 kPa on the prior generation—increasing coolant velocity across the system. The heat-transfer medium remains a non-conductive, insulating fluorinated fluid identical to the type utilized in AI server racks. In tandem with the internal mechanics, the phone implements a custom light-guide process positioned over the airflow duct. This allows RGB illumination to track visibly along the circulation route, providing visual feedback of the active cooling loop . Alongside thermal adjustments, Red Magic outlined several ergonomic and physical design refinements for the 12 Pro+:

Official launch details, configuration tiers, and pricing are slated to be revealed during Red Magic’s product launch event on October 15 .
